name: deepseek-harness-desktop
description: Deepseek - a Codex-like desktop app wrapping the official DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI
author: Deepseek Harness Desktop Contributors

scripts.dist:mac-arm64: npm run prepare:runtime -- --platform darwin --arch arm64 --prune-others && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac-x64: npm run prepare:runtime -- --platform darwin --arch x64 --prune-others && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:linux-x64: npm run prepare:runtime -- --platform linux --arch x64 --prune-others && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:linux-arm64: npm run prepare:runtime -- --platform linux --arch arm64 --prune-others && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
